subject: Startups
title: The Acquisition Negotiation
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Acquisition Negotiation.

hook.text: Snapchat turned down Facebook's $3 billion offer in 2013. Evan Spiegel was 23. Everyone thought he was crazy.

buildup.text: Acquisition talks start with an LOI: a letter of intent outlining the price, deal type, and timeline.

discovery.text: Founders negotiate on price, earn-outs, employee retention packages, and whether they stay or leave post-deal.

twist.text: Many deals collapse in due diligence. The buyer finds surprises: legal issues, inflated metrics, or messy cap tables.

climax.text: Snapchat later IPO'd at $24 billion. Spiegel's gamble paid off. But most rejected offers don't end so well.

punchline.text: Saying no to billions takes courage—or madness.

quiz.question: What document typically starts formal acquisition negotiations?
